QuestInfo.name: Luden's Gift
QuestInfo.0: #p2161002# seems to have some words of wisdom he'd like to share with you. Whatever he has to say may help you in your future battles. It should be worth a listen.
QuestInfo.1: #p2161002# says you should use the #r#t2439170##k. You've got nothing to lose, so open the Use tab and try it out.
QuestInfo.2: In order to become a stronger adventurer after your 4th job advancement, you must upgrade your skills using a #rmastery book#k. Find the mastery book of the skill you wish to advance.

0.0: You were waiting for awhile, weren't you? Do you remember the small gift I gave you before? It's a small box called #r#t2439170##k...\r\n#L0# #bOf course I remember. It has your name right on it.#l\n#k
0.1: Indeed it does! And now the time has come to reveal its power! It won't take long. Are you interested?

yes.0: First, open your #rUse window and double-click on the book I gave you#k. It will reveal its true essence to you!

no.0: You young people are so impatient.

1.0: Now, look in your Use inventory and you will find the #r#t2431789# or the #t2431790##k!
1.1: You used the #t2431789# or 30 after your 4th Job Advancement, so you can choose a skill to level up to 30.

yes.0: One more thing. You can use the #t2431789# when the skill's max level is 10, and then the #t2431790# when the skill's max level is 20.

default.0: Have you not used the #r#t2430559##k I gave you? Be brave and try it out!
